data.name: Holiday Inn Express Culiacan by IHG
data.address: Ave. Jesus Manuel Sarabia 2460, Blvd. Juan M. Zambada Fracc, Desarrollo Urbano Tres Rios, 80020 Culiacán Rosales, Sin., Mexico
data.description:
Set in a commercial district, this relaxed hotel is 6 km from Teatro Pablo de Villavicencio, 7 km from Aeropuerto Internacional Federal de Culiacán and 8 km from Jardín Botánico Culiacán.
The simple rooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living rooms, sofabeds and kitchenettes. Kids stay at no charge with an adult.
Parking and a hot breakfast buffet are complimentary. There's also a fitness room.
